Referral: sundin ang lokal na proseso.
Integrated system: pag-ugnayin ang mga serbisyo.
display_en:
Outpatient benefits: check what is covered.
Primary care: identify the provider and registration process.
Referral: follow the local pathway.
Integrated systems: coordinate services.
narration_fil: Itinataguyod ng UHC ang primary care, kasama ang outpatient benefits, pagpaparehistro sa primary care provider, at maayos na referral sa ibang serbisyo. Tumutulong ang primary care provider sa pag-ugnay ng pangangalaga; ang BHW ay umaalalay ayon sa pagsasanay at pangangasiwa. Layunin ng province-wide at city-wide health systems na pag-ugnayin ang mga serbisyo. Huwag ipalagay na available na sa lokalidad ang bawat serbisyo o referral arrangement. Tiyakin muna ang kasalukuyang provider, benepisyo, at proseso bago magpayo sa residente.
narration_en: UHC provides for stronger primary care, including outpatient benefits, registration with a primary care provider and coordinated referral to other services. A primary care provider helps navigate care; the BHW supports the resident within their training and supervision. Province-wide and city-wide health systems are intended to coordinate services. Do not assume every service or referral arrangement is already available locally. Check the current provider, benefit and referral procedure before advising a resident.

narration_fil:
Bumalik tayo kay Mang Ernesto. Sa apat na pagbabagong natutunan mo, hindi lahat ay parehong bilis dumating sa bawat barangay — may bago nang naramdaman, may hindi pa lubos.

Subukan mo: isipin ang sariling barangay mo. Saklaw na ba ng PhilHealth nang awtomatiko ang lahat dito? May kilala ka bang nakarehistro na sa primary care provider? Kung may kailangang i-refer, malinaw ba ang proseso, o nalilito pa rin kung saan dapat pumunta?

Hindi kahihiyan kung "hindi pa lubos" ang sagot mo sa ilan dito — iyon mismo ang unang hakbang: alamin muna kung alin ang totoong nangyayari sa iyong lugar bago mo isipin kung ano ang dapat pang gawin.
narration_en:
Back to Mang Ernesto. Of the four changes you just learned, not all of them arrive at the same pace in every barangay — some are already felt, some are not yet.

Try it: think about your own barangay. Is everyone there already automatically covered by PhilHealth? Do you know anyone registered with a primary care provider? If someone needs a referral, is the process clear, or is there still confusion about where to go?

It is not a failure if your answer to some of these is "not yet" — that is exactly the first step: knowing what has actually arrived in your own area before deciding what should happen next.
